label: Error Reporter
title: Global Error Reporter
subtitle: window 'error'/'unhandledrejection' listeners (error_reporter.js) — added 2026-08-19 after two real crashes produced zero visible symptoms without opening devtools. On any truly uncaught error/rejection: a tagged console.error, a crash_log.md line, and a capped toast (max 3 per session).

sections.title: Basic behavior
items: Trigger any uncaught error (e.g. temporarily break something, or catch a real one in the wild) — a toast appears reading “Something went wrong (...). Details logged to crash_log.md.”
The browser's own default uncaught-error console output still appears (not suppressed)
A separate “[dod-studio] Uncaught error: ...” (or “promise rejection”) line also appears in the console, easy to spot alongside the raw trace
A matching “[error] Uncaught ...” line with the message and stack appears in crash_log.md

sections.title: Rate limiting
items: A rapid-fire repeating error (e.g. the old recursion-loop class of bug) does not spam more than 3 toasts total in one session
Every occurrence still gets logged to crash_log.md and the console even after the 3-toast cap is hit — only the toast is capped, not the logging

sections.title: Doesn't interfere with already-handled errors
items: A normal IPC failure that already shows its own toast via an existing .catch() (e.g. a failed scan) does NOT also trigger the generic error-reporter toast — only genuinely uncaught errors do
